name: James Cordahi
title: Senior communications trainer and executive coach
profile: James is a communications trainer and ICF certified executive coach with 35 years' experience in international journalism, corporate affairs and government relations. He founded Bloomberg News' Middle East business coverage, co-ran the Reuters Gulf financial newsroom and later led corporate and government affairs for Abbott, Mondelez International and BlackBerry. He coaches senior executives in English, Arabic and French.

bullets: Delivers executive education in strategic communications, media relations, crisis communication and government affairs
Coaches senior leaders on executive presence and high-stakes communication in English, Arabic and French
